note: Light day, 10 min max, before your 11:00 HKPC interview. 事 si6 ×3 → recap STAR #1/#2 + intro lines → 6 new interview lines → Cantonese 我嚟面試 lines → one timed take. Skip if drained. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.prompt: One timed 60-sec take before your 11:00 interview: STAR #1 (estate movement) or the intro. Point → reason → example. Record, listen once, check 📜.
tasks.script:
Point: I needed a clear picture of how older residents moved around public housing estates.
Reason: The street-view data we first had was too patchy at community level.
Example: I used a government spatial-data API, reached about 98 percent coverage, and found activity was mainly in spring and winter, within two to three MTR stations, so I recommended a narrower distance buffer.

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat.

questions.q: Best order for an interview answer?
questions.explain: 先说重点，再讲原因，最后举例。

questions.q: Which means 'Thanks for giving me the chance'?
